distinguishes: exp-frames experiment 42's private transfer on Aztec's note and nullifier model, proved in Noir and checked in a VERIFY frame by gnark's Groth16 verifier, with its two nullifiers as EIP-8250 nonce keys, as the Hegota testnet mined it in block 491278: admitted at the head the testnet built on, dropped when the block spends its nullifiers, and refused as too low after it, as the testnet refused it; two stand-in double spends refused while it is pending; and Barretenberg's zero-knowledge verifier over the testnet's verify budget.
source: exp-frames branch exp/42-noir-transfer at 32586cc, experiments/42-noir-transfer/pool.groth16.json (the transfer, 0x10d33e62..., mined in block 491278, and the same bytes refused after it) and pool.json (the zero-knowledge pool's two refused attempts); blocks 491123, 491277 and 491278 by eth_getBlockByNumber, and each pool's balance by eth_getBalance at 491123 and 491277, 2026-10-21. The stand-ins are those bytes decoded and re-encoded with exp-frames' src/frametx at 85ee60d.

cases.name: the transfer the testnet mined is admitted, and dropped when block 491,278 spends its nullifiers
cases.derivation: The transfer is from the Groth16 pool, its sender and payer (FP-10, class sender), with no signature: frames [recent_root_verify (10000), VERIFY self flags 3 (490000, state 195840), SENDER insert (2500000, state 391680)], max_fee 100, tip 1, nonce_seq 0, and its two nullifiers as nonce keys, ascending. FP-5 skips the root frame (RR-4) and finds [self_verify]; FP-6: 10000 + 490000 = 500000, the testnet's max_verify_gas, so it fits. The VERIFY frame's state limit is 2 * 97920, the first use of two nonce keys. No key has a sequence at block 491,277, so both are at 0 (FP-7). The client is asked and answers valid, as the testnet simulated it before it was sent. Block 491,278 moves both keys to 1, so FP-15 step 1 drops the transfer.

cases.name: the same bytes again after block 491,278 are too low, as the testnet answered
cases.derivation: Both nullifiers are at sequence 1 and the transfer names 0 (FP-7), so the node refuses it without asking the client (SF-4). The testnet refused the same bytes with "Nonce mismatch: expected 1, got 0".

cases.name: the same bytes twice while the transfer is pending are known
cases.derivation: FP-2: the same hash is already held, and FP-2 runs before the client is asked.

cases.name: a stand-in that spends the same two notes to other outputs replaces the transfer only at the bump
cases.derivation: A stand-in: the mined bytes with the last byte of the SENDER frame's data changed, so another output note (decision record 0068). Its identity is the transfer's, (pool, both nullifiers, 0), and its fees are the same, so FP-12 refuses it as an underpriced replacement. The same stand-in with both fees raised by the bump, the tip from 1 to 2 and max_fee from 100 to 110, replaces the transfer (FP-12, price_bump 10), and the transfer's own bytes sent again are then the underpriced ones. When block 491,278 spends both nullifiers, FP-15 step 1 drops the replacement: whichever of the two the pool holds, at most one lands.

cases.name: a stand-in that spends one of the same notes beside another is refused while the transfer is pending, and is too low once it is mined
cases.derivation: A stand-in: the mined bytes with the second nullifier raised by one, so a double spend of the first note beside another note (decision record 0068). Its key set shares the first nullifier with the pending transfer and is not the same set, so FP-12 under disjoint-keys refuses it. Once block 491,278 spends the first nullifier, FP-7 refuses it without asking the client.

cases.name: Barretenberg's zero-knowledge verifier given its gas is over the testnet's verify budget
cases.derivation: The zero-knowledge pool's transfer with a VERIFY limit of 3600000: FP-6 sums 10000 + 3600000 = 3610000, over 500000, before the client is asked (SF-4). The testnet answered "prefix gas budget exceeded: 3610000 > 500000 (MAX_VERIFY_GAS)".

cases.name: with a limit that fits, its proof check runs out of gas and the prefix reverts
cases.derivation: The same transfer with a VERIFY limit of 490000 fits FP-6, so the client is asked; Barretenberg's verifier needs 3494968 gas, and the testnet answered "validation prefix frame reverted", which SF-4 maps to ErrFramePrefixReverted.
